name: Bank Shots & Transition
summary: Warm up the hands, shoot bank shots from the angles, rotate to help like a defender, then rebound and push the ball for full-court finishes.

drills.name: Spider Dribble Series
drills.summary: Wake up your fingertips with quick touches under your body.
steps: Get in a wide stance with the ball between your feet.
Tap right hand front, left hand front, right hand back, left hand back.
Keep the dribbles low and fast for 30 seconds.
Rest 10 seconds, then go again and try to beat your speed.
Finish with 30 seconds of spider dribbles with your eyes on the rim.

drills.name: Bank Shot Angles
drills.summary: Learn to use the glass from the 45-degree spots.
steps: Start on the right block at a 45-degree angle to the rim.
Aim for the top corner of the small square and shoot 5 bank shots.
Step back to just inside the lane line and shoot 5 more.
Move out to the short elbow area and shoot 5 more.
Switch to the left side and repeat all three spots.

drills.name: Help Spot Rotations
drills.summary: Move from the weak side to the help spot before the drive gets there.
steps: Set one cone on the weak-side wing, one in the middle of the lane, one on the block.
Start in stance at the wing cone with one hand pointing at the ball, one at your player.
Sprint to the lane cone and stop square with both feet set.
Show high hands and yell "Help!", then close out back to the wing cone.
Repeat from the other side. Stop on balance every time, no falling.

drills.name: Rebound-and-Push Finishes
drills.summary: Grab your own miss, push it the length of the floor and finish under speed.
steps: Toss the ball off the backboard and grab it high with two hands.
Chin the ball and pivot to the outside.
Speed dribble up the side of the floor in 4-5 dribbles past half court.
Cut to the rim and finish a layup with the outside hand.
Rebound and come back the other way. Alternate sides every trip.
